headline: Stellarys Build
title: Stellarys Build | Shadow Magic and Shooting Stars | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Stellarys is a Dark damage dealer, and its highest stat is attack. Run Shadow Magic, which leaves a clone behind for twenty seconds. Add Shooting Stars, whose homing stars stack a damage boost with every hit. Your ultimate is Comet Aureus, a heavy magical strike. Ferocious Fang is a popular held item for extra attack. Put your points into attack first. Which Dark Aniimo do you main? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Stellarys build: a Dark damage dealer using Shadow Magic, Shooting Stars and the Comet Aureus ultimate, with Ferocious Fang as a popular held item.
joke: Even the clone wants a turn at the stars.
